test_title: PYST 122: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23 Jan, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Prem is an immediate neighbour of Nolan and Suraj. Madhu is sitting third to the right of Prem. Suraj is sitting second to the right of Madhu. Raj is an immediate neighbour of Madhu and Nolan. Steve is sitting third to the right of Nolan. Prem is sitting second to the right of Steve. Who is the immediate neighbour of Raj and Prem?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information is as:

1. Madhu is sitting third to the right of Prem and Suraj is sitting second to the right of Madhu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6d2d8c2619d381c8878aebfcc7e74eb11f4f94535d87735704d1b47564b2e59.png] 

2. Raj is an immediate neighbour of Madhu and Nolan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e98422ea260c047d25508d252e651aa94cda7c58ce72d383b04508ba5f7e7eaf.png] 

Here,** 'Nolan'** is the immediate neighbour of Raj and Prem.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
